description: This file defines a class that transforms 'background' attributes in HTML to CSS style declarations, specifically converting proprietary background attributes into CSS background-image styles during HTML purification.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrTransform_Background
classes.description: A class responsible for transforming the 'background' attribute of HTML tags into CSS styles during purification.

methods.name: transform
methods.description: Transforms the 'background' attribute into a CSS background-image style if present, by confiscating the attribute and prepending the CSS style.
